entries.name: Master's in Systems Engineering
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in systems engineering, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Teaching English as a Second Language
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in teaching English as a second language, awarded by universities.
variants: Master's degree in Teaching English as a Second Language
Masters degree in Teaching English as a Second Language

entries.name: Master's in Theater
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in theater, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Theology
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in theology, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Urban Planning
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in urban planning, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Zoology
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in zoology, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Matriculation certificate
entries.definition: A certificate awarded for passing the final secondary-school examinations, which in some countries qualifies the holder for university entry.

entries.name: Medication Aide/Assistant Certification Examination
entries.definition: An examination that leads to certification as a medication aide or assistant, who gives routine medicines under nursing supervision.

entries.name: Microsoft Azure certification
entries.definition: Any of the credentials Microsoft awards for skills on its Azure cloud platform.

entries.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
entries.definition: An entry-level Microsoft certification that shows basic knowledge of cloud concepts and Azure services.

entries.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
entries.definition: A Microsoft certification for architects who design cloud and hybrid solutions on Azure, covering compute, storage, networking and security.

entries.name: Microsoft Certified Systems Administrator
entries.definition: A Microsoft certification for professionals who manage Windows server environments and networks.

entries.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Field Service certification
entries.definition: A Microsoft certification that shows skill in configuring and implementing Dynamics 365 Field Service.

entries.name: Mobile Electronics Certified Professional
entries.definition: A certification program for installers of vehicle audio, security and other mobile electronics.

entries.name: National Certified Patient Care Technician
entries.definition: A certification for patient care technicians awarded by the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT).

entries.name: National Certified School Counselor
entries.definition: A certification for school counselors awarded by the National Board for Certified Counselors (NBCC).

entries.name: National Registry Emergency Medical Technician
entries.definition: An emergency medical technician certification awarded by the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians in the United States.

entries.name: Nationally Certified School Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for school nurses awarded by the National Board for Certification of School Nurses.

entries.name: NCIDQ Certification
entries.definition: A certification for interior designers awarded by the Council for Interior Design Qualification (CIDQ) to those who meet its education and experience requirements and pass its exams.

entries.name: Neonatal Resuscitation Program
entries.definition: A training programme from the American Academy of Pediatrics and the American Heart Association on resuscitating newborns.

entries.name: Nurse licensure
entries.definition: A licence, issued by a state or national nursing board, that legally permits a person to practise as a nurse.

entries.name: Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: An advanced practice nursing credential for registered nurses with graduate education who are licensed by a state and certified in a population focus.

entries.name: Nutrition and Dietetics Technician, Registered
entries.definition: A credential from the Commission on Dietetic Registration for nutrition and dietetics technicians who have completed an accredited programme and passed the registration exam.

entries.name: Occupational Health and Safety Technologist
entries.definition: A safety credential for technicians who support occupational health and safety work, awarded by the Board of Certified Safety Professionals (BCSP).

entries.name: Oncology Certified Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who care for people with cancer, awarded by the Oncology Nursing Certification Corporation.

entries.name: Oracle Certified Associate
entries.definition: The entry-level tier of Oracle's certification program, awarded by Oracle after passing an exam in a product area such as Java or Oracle Database.

entries.name: Oracle Certified Java Programmer
entries.definition: An Oracle certification, earlier offered by Sun Microsystems, showing that a person can write programs in Java SE.

entries.name: Oracle Certified Master
entries.definition: The highest tier of Oracle's certification program, awarded for passing advanced exams and, in some tracks, a practical assessment.

entries.name: Oracle Database 11g Administrator Certified Associate
entries.definition: An associate-level Oracle certification for administrators of Oracle Database 11g.

entries.name: Orthopaedic Nurse Certified
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who work in orthopaedic nursing, awarded by the Orthopaedic Nurses Certification Board.

entries.name: OSHA safety certificate
entries.definition: A card or certificate showing completion of occupational safety training under the United States Occupational Safety and Health Administration, such as its 10-hour and 30-hour Outreach courses.

entries.name: Outdoor Emergency Care
entries.definition: A National Ski Patrol course and certification in emergency care for injured or ill people in outdoor settings such as ski areas.

entries.name: Passenger endorsement
entries.definition: A commercial driver's licence endorsement that permits driving vehicles that carry passengers, such as buses.

entries.name: Peace officer certification
entries.definition: A certification, awarded by a state or local peace officer standards body, showing that a person has met the training and screening requirements to serve as a sworn peace officer.

entries.name: Pediatric Advanced Life Support
entries.definition: An American Heart Association course and certification in recognising and treating seriously ill or injured infants and children.

entries.name: Pega Certified Business Architect
entries.definition: A certification from Pega Systems for business architects and analysts who capture requirements and design case lifecycles in Pega applications.

entries.name: Pega Certified Decisioning Consultant
entries.definition: A certification from Pega Systems for specialists who design decision strategies and next-best-action logic in Pega's decisioning products.

entries.name: Pega Certified Lead System Architect
entries.definition: The highest certification in Pega Systems' architect path, for architects who design large, enterprise-scale Pega applications.

entries.name: Pega Certified Senior System Architect
entries.definition: A certification from Pega Systems, above System Architect, for developers who design and build more complex Pega applications.

entries.name: Pega Certified System Architect
entries.definition: A certification from Pega Systems for developers who build and configure Pega applications; the entry level of its architect path.
